title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - SQL injection in backend data search and export in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4,…
description: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in the backend data search and export functionality of the Joomla Visforms extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.4 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.1. The issue arises because search filters and form IDs in the backend data view and export are not properly sanitized, allowing backend users to inject SQL commands.
